objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperless artifact in DHC VISION, including policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, and other documents.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The selected type of the document.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: The level used to differentiate and structure documents.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties for relevant companies.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties for areas of validity.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number_per_type
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number assigned for each document type by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title component of the document name.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Default composed name of the document.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata maintained automatically or by the user.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to purpose.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version information for the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the document in its status network or workflow.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign the author of the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers for the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers for the document.

attributes.name: releaser_including_translation
attributes.description: Attribute used for releaser assignment including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document validity count starts.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which an extended validity check is necessary.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from date and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which an invalidated document is archived.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect e-mail notification on next released version.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect workflow task distribution on next released version.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Language version used as the original for translation.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which authorized readers can see a released language version.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specifies in which clients the document is visible in a multi-client system.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting the document type.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata and document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit the content of the document.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document, after which conversion to PDF occurs.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: assign_authorizations
evts.description: Assign read and change rights to groups, users, or persons for a document.

evts.name: initiate_approval_process
evts.description: Start the workflow-supported approval process for a document.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check document content in the release workflow.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Release the document after workflow completion.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid released document causing creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation and create a new document version.

evts.name: process_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Process a system-created request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare document and attachments invalid and archive them.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Reactivate previously invalidated documents and attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign user groups or persons to the document distribution list.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipients confirm acknowledgement of a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content into another language.

evts.name: release_language_version
evts.description: Check and release a translated language version with workflow support.
